How it works

01

People trade $STOCKP

Trades route through the Raydium pool. The creator fees accrue inside the locked position instead of landing in a wallet.

3%fee to treasury Lockedposition Automaticno claim step On-chainverifiable
02

The treasury buys the basket

Collected fees are swapped for the basket, each line on the venue where its market actually is. Every purchase is split down the middle the moment it settles.

8assets Weightedequal / 8 50%to holders 50%to the floor
03

Holders receive, and keep their tokens

Hold at least 100,000 $STOCKP and your share is sent to your wallet every epoch - automatically, no claim step. The bigger your share of supply, the bigger your share of the distribution - strictly proportional.

100,000tokens Pro rataby holding No claimauto-sent Every epochrepeats
04

The floor only goes up

The reserved half backs the token. Anyone can burn to redeem their share of it - the exit fee stays behind, so every exit lifts the floor for everyone still holding.

Burnto redeem Exit feestays in Supplyonly falls Floornever drops

/ STOCKP /

A treasury-backed token on Solana.

$STOCKP is built around one simple mechanism: trading turns into fees, fees flow into a treasury, the treasury acquires real assets, and eligible holders are rewarded automatically. The goal is to turn trading activity into a growing on-chain treasury while rewarding those who hold. Trade. Accumulate. Participate.

Mechanism

01 People trade $STOCKP

Every buy or sell on Solana generates a fee. Trading is the engine that feeds the whole system.
02 3% of every trade flows to the treasury

A 3% buy/sell fee is charged on every transaction and directed to the treasury. Nothing is skimmed into a wallet.

 3%
03 The treasury acquires assets

Treasury funds are used to acquire the protocol's supported assets on-chain.
04 Accumulation is split in two

Half of the treasury is allocated to holder rewards. The other half is retained as the treasury floor.

 50 / 50
05 Eligible holders are rewarded automatically

No claims. No staking. No burning. No redemption. Simply hold 100,000+ $STOCKP to participate.

Treasury

A portion of every trading fee flows into the treasury. Treasury funds are used to acquire the protocol's supported assets.

The treasury is allocated between:

  • 50% - Holder rewards. Set aside to reward eligible holders.
  • 50% - Treasury floor. Retained as the protocol's underlying asset base.

Automatic rewards

Eligible holders receive rewards automatically. There is nothing to claim, nothing to stake, nothing to burn, and nothing to redeem.

Hold at least 100,000+ $STOCKP to participate. Rewards are calculated on time-weighted holdings and distributed automatically.

Simply hold to participate. The only requirement is keeping 100,000+ $STOCKP in your wallet. Rewards are weighted over time so they reflect genuine, continued holding rather than a snapshot.

Treasury floor

The treasury retains a portion of its acquired assets as the protocol's underlying asset base.

The floor represents the value of the assets held by the treasury relative to the circulating supply. It is not a guaranteed token price.

Liquidity

$STOCKP is built for Solana. Launch and liquidity infrastructure are handled through the project's Solana-based launch setup.

Contracts

All official contract addresses will be published here and should be verified on-chain before interacting with the protocol.

Risk

$STOCKP is a speculative digital asset. The protocol does not guarantee profits, appreciation, liquidity, or recovery of capital. Treasury assets and $STOCKP can lose value. Do your own research.
